ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:1 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region covering approximately 85% of the visible fluke. High-intensity white/grey mottling is concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe. Distinct white clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel amplitude ranging from 3 to 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve shows a smooth concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, ending in sharp convex points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized primarily on the leading and distal edges of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) on the fluke tips and irregular trailing edge notches indicating minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-intensity white focal spot is visible in the lower-medial region of the left lobe.
